mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, product_id, quantity, status, create_time FROM `gouwuche` ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT g.id, g.user_id, g.product_id, g.quantity, g.status, g.create_time, p.name AS product_name, p.price AS product_price, p.image_url AS product_image FROM `gouwuche` g LEFT JOIN `shangpin` p ON g.product_id = p.id WHERE g.user_id = #{userId} AND g.status = 1 ORDER BY g.id DESC
SELECT id, user_id, product_id, quantity, status FROM `gouwuche` WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId} AND status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `gouwuche` (user_id, product_id, quantity, status, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE `gouwuche` SET status = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1
